product.title: Aglaonema Snow White
product.description: Looks like someone dusted every leaf with snow. Cool white speckles brighten indoor corners, and its dependable nature makes the whole effect feel effortless.

product.description: All the toughness of a snake plant, folded into a perfect little rosette. Sculptural, tidy, and happy to be ignored. A quiet survivor for small corners.

product.description: Small leaves, sharp style. Crisp white edges make this compact money plant look polished even on the tiniest shelf. A little showpiece without high-maintenance behaviour.

product.title: Money Plant Marble Queen
product.description: No two leaves marble the same. Creamy swirls make it look collected and expensive, while its easy money-plant nature keeps the drama low.

product.title: Money Plant Green
product.description: The classic easy-going climber. Glossy green vines, quick growth, and almost no attitude. The plant that makes every first-timer feel naturally gifted.

product.description: Like switching on a light. Electric lime vines brighten dull shelves and grow without making a fuss. Let it trail, climb, or spill wherever you need joy.

product.title: Snake Dwarf
product.description: Short, sturdy, and almost impossible to offend. Upright patterned leaves stay neat in the smallest spaces. The tiny tank we recommend to serial plant forgetters.

product.title: Areca Palm
product.description: The instant corner-softener. Feathery fronds make a room feel lighter, fresher, and more alive. Give it warmth and consistency, and it keeps unfolding for you.

product.title: China Palm

product.title: Syngonium White
product.description: Soft arrow-shaped leaves brushed with creamy white. Neat, quick-growing, and surprisingly forgiving. The calm little brightener for desks and quiet corners.

product.title: Jade
product.description: The tiny tree with old-soul charm. Plump, coin-shaped leaves, slow growth, and almost no drama. A lucky little companion for sunny desks and forgetful plant parents.

product.title: ZZ Plant
product.description: The plant that forgives everything. Glossy, deep-green leaves that stay shiny even when you forget it exists. Thrives in dim corners, survives missed waterings, and still looks like you tried.
